Simulate circular-circular data

Source: R/directional-simulation.R
simulate_toroidal.Rd

Simulates examples on the torus, where both theta and phi are angles in radians.

Usage

simulate_toroidal(
  n = 500,
  scenario = c("nonlinear", "diagonal", "anti_diagonal", "multimodal", "independent"),
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

n

Number of observations.

scenario

Dependence pattern to simulate.

seed

Optional random seed.

Value

A data frame with columns theta, phi and scenario.

See also

Other directional simulation helpers: simulate_cylindrical()

Examples

simulate_toroidal(n = 30, scenario = "diagonal", seed = 1)
